function t2.value34(p54)
    local p54Position = p54.Position

    if t2.value8.SilentPrediction and p54.Parent then
        local HumanoidRootPart = p54.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if HumanoidRootPart then
            p54Position += HumanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity * t2.value8.SilentPredictionTime
        end
    end

    return p54Position
end
function t2.value35()
    local AimFOV = t2.value8.AimFOV
    local t4
    local MouseLocation = t2.value2:GetMouseLocation()
    for _, player in pairs(t2.value1:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= t2.value4 and player.Character then
            local v156 = player ~= t2.value4 and if not t2.value32(player) then t2.value8.ESP_ShowEnemies else t2.value8.ESP_ShowAllies

            if not v156 then
                v156 = not t2.value4.Team
            end

            if v156 then
                local Humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                if Humanoid and Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                    local SilentAimPart = t2.value8.SilentAimPart
                    local SilentAimPart2 = player.Character:FindFirstChild(SilentAimPart)

                    if not SilentAimPart2 then
                        SilentAimPart2 = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Torso")

                        if not SilentAimPart2 then
                            SilentAimPart2 = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                            if not SilentAimPart2 then
                                SilentAimPart2 = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    if SilentAimPart2 then
                        local v160 = t2.value34(SilentAimPart2)
                        local v161, v162 = t2.value6:WorldToViewportPoint(v160)

                        if v162 then
                            local Magnitude = (Vector2.new(v161.X, v161.Y) - MouseLocation).Magnitude
                            local Magnitude2 = (v160 - t2.value6.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
                            local v165 = Magnitude < AimFOV

                            if v165 then
                                v165 = Magnitude2 < t2.value8.AimRange
                            end

                            if v165 then
                                AimFOV = Magnitude
                                t4 = {
									part = SilentAimPart2,
									position = v160,
									player = player,
									screenPos = v161
								}
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    t2.value33.target = t4

    return t4
end
function t2.value36()
    if t2.value8.SilentHitChance >= 100 then
        return true
    end

    if t2.value8.SilentHitChance <= 0 then
        return false
    end

    return math.random(1, 100) <= t2.value8.SilentHitChance
end

    end

    local v171 = t2.value8.SilentMethod ~= "MouseMove"

    if v171 then
        v171 = t2.value8.SilentMethod ~= "Hybrid"
    end

    if v171 then
        return
    end

    if not t2.value7 then
        return
    end

    if not t2.value33.hitRoll then
        return
    end

    local v172 = t2.value35()

    if not v172 then
        return
    end

    local v173, v174 = t2.value6:WorldToViewportPoint(v172.position)

    if not v174 then
        return
    end

    local MouseLocation = t2.value2:GetMouseLocation()
    local v176 = (v173.X - MouseLocation.X) * t2.value8.SilentMouseScale
    local v177 = (v173.Y - MouseLocation.Y) * t2.value8.SilentMouseScale

end)

                end
            else
                t2.value39 = false
            end
        elseif t2.value39 then
            t2.value39 = false

            local value40 = t2.value40

            if value40 then
                value40 = t2.value40.Parent
            end

            if value40 then
                t2.value40:Destroy()
            end

            local value41 = t2.value41

            if value41 then
                value41 = t2.value41.Parent
            end

            if value41 then
                t2.value41:Destroy()
            end
        end

        if t2.value8.Noclip then
            local GetDescendants = Character.GetDescendants

            for _, v in pairs(GetDescendants(Character)) do
                if v:IsA("BasePart") then
                    v.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
        end
    elseif not t2.value39 then
    end

    for _, v in pairs(t2.value38) do
        local v236 = v
        local player = v236.player
        local v238 = player and player.Character
        local v239 = v238 and v238:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local v240 = v238

        if v238 then
            v240 = v238:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        end

        local v241 = v238

        if v238 then
            v241 = v239

            if v239 then
                v241 = v240

                if v240 then
                    v241 = false

                    if v239.Health > 0 then
                        v241 = player ~= t2.value4 and if not t2.value32(player) then t2.value8.ESP_ShowEnemies else t2.value8.ESP_ShowAllies
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        if t2.value8.ESP_Master and v241 then
            v236.bb.Enabled = true
            v236.bb.Adornee = v240

            local v242 = t2.value32(player)

            v236.name.Visible = t2.value8.ESP_Name
            v236.name.Text = player.Name

            local name = v236.name

            if v242 then
                v242 = t2.value8.AllyOutlineColor
            end

            if not v242 then
                v242 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            end

            name.TextColor3 = v242

            local v244 = math.floor(v239.Health)
            local MaxHealth = v239.MaxHealth
            local v246 = math.clamp(v244 / MaxHealth, 0, 1)

            v236.health.Visible = t2.value8.ESP_Health
            v236.health.Text = v244 .. "/" .. math.floor(MaxHealth) .. " HP"
            v236.health.TextColor3 = t2.value8.MainColor

            local v247 = if not (v246 > 0.5) then if not (v246 > 0.25) then Color3.new(1, 0.2, 0.2) else Color3.new(1, v246 * 1.6, 0) else Color3.new(0, v246, 0.2)

            v236.hbar.Visible = t2.value8.ESP_Health
            v236.hfill.Size = UDim2.new(v246, 0, 1, 0)
            v236.hfill.BackgroundColor3 = v247
            v236.dist.Visible = t2.value8.ESP_Distance

            if t2.value8.ESP_Distance and v191 then
                v236.dist.Text = "[" .. math.floor((v191.Position - v240.Position).Magnitude) .. "m]"
            end
        else
            v236.bb.Enabled = false
        end

        if t2.value8.ESP_Chams and v241 then
            local v248 = not v236.hl

            if not v248 then
                v248 = not v236.hl.Parent
            end

            if v248 then
                v236.hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
                v236.hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
            end

            v236.hl.Parent = v238
            v236.hl.Adornee = v238

            local v249 = t2.value32(player)
            local hl = v236.hl
            local v251 = v249

            if v249 then
                v251 = t2.value8.AllyOutlineColor
            end

            if not v251 then
                v251 = t2.value8.ChamsOutlineColor
            end

            hl.OutlineColor = v251

            local hl2 = v236.hl

            if v249 then
                v249 = t2.value8.AllyFillColor
            end

            if not v249 then
                v249 = t2.value8.ChamsFillColor
            end

            hl2.FillColor = v249
            v236.hl.FillTransparency = t2.value8.ChamsFillTransparency
            v236.hl.OutlineTransparency = t2.value8.ChamsOutlineTransparency
            v236.hl.Enabled = true
        elseif v236.hl then
            pcall(function()
                v236.hl.Enabled = false
            end)
        end
    end

    t2.value33.target = nil
end)
t2.value2.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    local InfJump = t2.value8.InfJump

    if InfJump then
        InfJump = t2.value4.Character
    end

    if InfJump then
        local Humanoid = t2.value4.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

        if Humanoid then
            Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
        end
    end
end)
